login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in to your account to open your projects.

register.title: Create account
register.body: Create an account to start working on your documents.

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.body: Enter your e-mail and we will send a link to set a new password.

reset.title: New password
reset.body: Choose a new password for your account.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: You have been invited to HSE Doc Studio. Finish signing up with the invitation link.

verify.title: E-mail confirmation
verify.body: Checking the link from the e-mail and confirming your address.

firstRun.title: First run
firstRun.body: This installation is not set up yet: create an administrator, then you can invite people.

authError.title: Sign-in failed
authError.body: Signing in through the external service did not complete. Try again or sign in with a password.

login.ssoOnlyBody: This installation signs you in through an external provider.
login.sessionEndedHint: Sign in again. Unsaved changes on the previous screen may not have been saved.
login.noMethods: No sign-in methods are configured. Contact the installation administrator.

errors.invalid_credentialsHint: Check the keyboard layout and case. If you forgot the password, reset it with the link.
errors.email_not_verified: Your email is not verified yet.
errors.email_not_verifiedHint: Open the link from the email we sent when you registered.
errors.pending_approval: Your account is awaiting administrator approval.
errors.pending_approvalHint: Sign-in will work once it is approved. We will email you.
errors.sso_login_required: This email can only sign in through single sign-on (SSO).
errors.csrf_failedHint: We have refreshed it: sign in again.
errors.networkHint: Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknownHint: Please try again a little later.

oidc_denied.title: Sign-in cancelled
oidc_denied.body: The external service did not get your confirmation. Try again or sign in with a password.

oidc_failed.title: The external service did not respond
oidc_failed.body: Sign-in failed on the provider side. Please try again.

sso_login_required.title: Single sign-on required
sso_login_required.body: A password does not work for this email: sign in through the external provider.

pending_approval.title: Account awaiting approval
pending_approval.body: An administrator has not approved the registration yet. Sign-in will work once it is approved.

email_not_verified.title: Email not verified
email_not_verified.body: Open the link from the email, then sign in again.

domain_not_allowed.title: Email domain not allowed
domain_not_allowed.body: Registration is open only to email addresses of allowed domains.

registration_closed.title: Registration closed
registration_closed.body: New accounts are created by the installation administrator.

invitation_required.title: Invitation required
invitation_required.body: Registration is by invitation only. Ask an administrator to send you a link.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Wait a moment and sign in again.

unknown.title: Sign-in did not finish
unknown.body: The reason is unknown. Try again or sign in with a password.

register.name: Name
register.emailLocked: The email comes from the invitation and cannot be changed.
register.passwordShort_one: The password is shorter than {{count}} character.
register.passwordShort_other: The password is shorter than {{count}} characters.

hint.domains: Registration is open to email addresses of allowed domains. Other addresses need an invitation.
hint.invited: {{who}} invited you. Choose a password and your account is ready.
hint.invitedOrg: {{who}} invited you to the "{{org}}" organization. Choose a password and your account is ready.

errors.registration_closedHint: New accounts are created by the installation administrator.
errors.domain_not_allowed: Registration is available only for emails of allowed domains.
errors.invitation_requiredHint: Ask an administrator to send you an invitation link.
errors.invitation_invalid: The invitation is invalid or expired.
errors.password_policy: This password is not accepted: it is too simple.
errors.rate_limitedHint: Wait a little and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: The session is out of date.
errors.csrf_failedHint: We already refreshed it: submit the form again.
errors.networkHint: Check your connection and try again.

closed.title: Registration is closed
closed.body: New accounts are created by the installation administrator. If you already have an account, just sign in.

invite_required.title: Registration by invitation
invite_required.body: Open the invitation link sent by an administrator or an organization owner.

invitation_invalid.title: The invitation is invalid
invitation_invalid.body: The link has expired, was already used or was revoked. Ask for a new one.

unreachable.title: The server did not respond
unreachable.body: Could not check the invitation. Reload the page in a minute.

check_email.title: Check your email
check_email.body: If {{email}} is eligible, we sent a message with a link to it. Open the link to confirm the address.

check_email_link.title: One step left: confirm your email
check_email_link.body: Copy the link below and open it to confirm {{email}}.

pending_approval.title: Your request awaits approval
pending_approval.body: An administrator will review the registration. Once it is approved, sign-in will work and an email will arrive at {{email}}.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If there is an account for {{email}}, we sent a message with a link to set a new password.
sent.noSmtp: Email is not configured on this installation, so nothing is sent. If the account exists, contact the installation administrator: access cannot be restored without email here.

done.title: Password changed
done.body: You can now sign in with the new password. Other devices will be signed out.

expired.title: The link is invalid or expired
expired.body: A new-password link works for a short time and only once. Request a new one.

done.title: Email confirmed
done.body: The address is confirmed, you can sign in.

invalid.title: The link is invalid or expired
invalid.body: The link works for a short time and only once. We can send a new one.

resend.lead: Enter your email and we will send a new link.

resent.title: Done
resent.body: If {{email}} is waiting for confirmation, we sent a new message to it.
resent.noSmtp: Email is not configured on this installation, so nothing is sent. Contact the installation administrator to confirm the address.

unreachable.title: The server did not respond
unreachable.body: Could not check the link. It is not used up yet: try again.

errors.token_invalid: The link is invalid or expired.
errors.password_policy: This password is not accepted: it is too short or too simple.
errors.rate_limitedHint: Wait a little and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: The session is out of date.
errors.csrf_failedHint: We already refreshed it: repeat the action.
errors.networkHint: Check your connection and try again.
